evidence: Numerical tolerances remain TBD until independent M4-00 reference tests are frozen.

array.position_source: explicit configuration; never inferred from network order

input.rfso_scope: input format/rate/pacing only; no RFSoC PFB/FFT/packetizer development

beam.weights: runtime arbitrary complex I/Q16 per beam/input/frequency
beam.voltage_accumulation: wide accumulate then one final rounding/saturation
beam.missing_source: zero contribution plus explicit invalid/missing metadata

fft2d.zero_padding_64: denser angle sampling only; does not add physical antennas or resolution
fft2d.path: calibration/map/zero-pad, row FFT, transpose, column FFT, index/pair, products, integration

precision.fixed_point_rule: RTL and fixed-point oracle must match sample-by-sample and per flag
precision.rounding_rule: no mid-accumulation saturation that changes scientific result for reordered inputs

outputs.interface: finite ready/valid FIFO with explicit backpressure/loss policy

integration.time_tag: 64-bit scientific time; never converted to JavaScript Number
integration.window_rule: integer number of spectra; missing blocks do not extend or fill the planned window

tolerances.statistics_length: 32 deterministic seeds for M4-00 study; RTL/IP revalidation required
tolerances.normalization: relative L2/RMS against independent floating reference with the same integer-coded inputs
tolerances.note: Thresholds are not relaxed after synthesis; actual RTL/IP error must be measured separately.

unknowns: exact CMY latency and fixed-point rounding behavior in 2025.1
real antenna coordinates and primary beams are not yet available; synthetic layout/model must be labeled
DDR/MIG and board output remain out of scope for M4
K/integration output bandwidth and finite-FIFO overload policy must be frozen after resource ledger
